caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with ornate geometric and symmetrical patterns on its backrest and seat supports. The bench is shown in three views: a front elevation, a side elevation, and a detail of the armrest. The front view features a long seat with vertical and horizontal wooden pieces; the upper backrest contains a zigzag and diamond motif carved or inlaid periodically along its length, while the lower sections of the backrest and the supporting bars underneath the seat also feature scalloped edges and triangular designs. Distinctive, shaped wooden spindles connect the upper and lower parts, alternating in form. The side view shows the contour of the bench’s seat and backrest, with dimensions sketched beside the lines, and the angle of the backrest is depicted as reclined. Above the side elevation, an overhead view of a slightly curved armrest piece is shown. The bench structure is primarily shaded in brown tones, indicating wood, with light blue highlights on some of the carved decorations. Measurements are written in pencil, and the drawing is executed on a beige background.
title: Mission Bench
